Good morning, how are you today?.g: How are you? 是常用问候，常答 Fine, thanks. And you?

Could you speak a little more slowly, pl.t: 请你说得稍微慢一点，好吗？
Could you speak a little more slowly, pl.g: more slowly 是副词比较级，修饰动词 speak。

I would like a cup of tea with a little.t: 我想要一杯加少许牛奶的茶。
w: 想要（比 want 更礼貌）
I would like a cup of tea with a little.g: a little 修饰不可数名词，a few 修饰可数名词。

What time does the next train leave?.g: 时刻表上的安排用一般现在时表示将来。

Please turn off the lights when you leav.g: turn off 反义为 turn on；代词须放中间：turn them off。

It looks like it is going to rain this a.t: 看起来今天下午要下雨了。
It looks like it is going to rain this a.g: be going to 表示根据眼前迹象判断将发生的事。

Thank you so much for your help yesterda.t: 非常感谢你昨天的帮助。
Thank you so much for your help yesterda.g: thank sb for sth/doing sth，for 后接名词或动名词。

Excuse me, where is the nearest post off.t: 打扰一下，最近的邮局在哪里？
w: adj. 最近的（near 的最高级）
Excuse me, where is the nearest post off.g: 向陌生人问路先说 Excuse me 引起注意。

I'm sorry, but I didn't catch your name..t: 抱歉，我没听清你的名字。
I'm sorry, but I didn't catch your name..g: catch 在此意为“听清”，不是“抓住”。

Let's meet in front of the library at th.t: 我们三点在图书馆前面见吧。
Let's meet in front of the library at th.g: Let's + 动词原形 表示提议；具体钟点前用 at。

My brother practices the piano every eve.t: 我哥哥每天晚饭后练钢琴。
My brother practices the piano every eve.g: 乐器前通常加 the：play/practise the piano。

How much does this blue jacket cost?.g: cost 的主语是物品；问价也可说 How much is it?

I usually walk to school with my best fr.t: 我通常和我最好的朋友一起走路上学。
I usually walk to school with my best fr.g: go to school 中 school 不加 the，指去上学。

May I have some more of this delicious s.t: 我可以再来点这道美味的汤吗？
w: 我可以……吗？（礼貌请求许可）
May I have some more of this delicious s.g: 请求、提供时的疑问句常用 some 而非 any。

Can I borrow your pencil for a minute?.t: 我能借用一下你的铅笔吗？
Can I borrow your pencil for a minute?.g: borrow 是向别人借，lend 是借给别人。

I hope you like your birthday present..t: 希望你喜欢你的生日礼物。
I hope you like your birthday present..g: hope 后接从句，that 常省略。

We are having fish and rice for dinner t.g: 现在进行时可表示已安排好的近期计划。

Please close the window because it is ge.t: 请关上窗户，因为这里越来越冷了。
Please close the window because it is ge.g: get + 形容词 表示状态变化，进行时强调“渐渐”。

The movie starts at half past seven, so.t: 电影七点半开始，所以我们得快点。
The movie starts at half past seven, so.g: past 表示“过了几点”，to 表示“差几分到几点”。

My favorite season is autumn because the.t: 我最喜欢的季节是秋天，因为树叶会变成红色和金色。
My favorite season is autumn because the.g: turn + 颜色形容词 表示颜色变化；leaf 复数为 leaves。

Excuse me, is this seat taken?.t: 打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？
Excuse me, is this seat taken?.g: 询问座位的固定说法；没人可答 No, go ahead.

She speaks English and French very well..t: 她英语和法语都说得很好。
She speaks English and French very well..g: well 是副词修饰动词，不能说 speaks very good。

I left my umbrella on the bus this morni.t: 今天早上我把伞落在公交车上了。
w: v. 遗忘，落下（过去式 left）
I left my umbrella on the bus this morni.g: “把东西落在某处”用 leave，不用 forget。

Don't forget to take your keys when you.g: forget to do 忘了要做；forget doing 忘了做过。

The children are playing football in the.t: 孩子们正在公园里踢足球。
w: n. 孩子们（child 的复数）
The children are playing football in the.g: 球类运动前不加 the：play football。

What would you like to drink with your m.g: What would you like...? 是餐厅点单的礼貌问法。

The supermarket is just around the corne.g: around the corner 也可喻指“即将到来”。

Would you mind waiting here for a few mi.t: 你介意在这儿等几分钟吗？
Would you mind waiting here for a few mi.g: mind 后接动名词；同意时答 No, not at all.

I get up at seven every morning and have.t: 我每天早上七点起床，和家人一起吃早饭。
I get up at seven every morning and have.g: 三餐前一般不加冠词：have breakfast/lunch/dinner。

Our cat likes to sleep in the sun near t.t: 我们家的猫喜欢在窗边晒着太阳睡觉。
Our cat likes to sleep in the sun near t.g: like to do 与 like doing 都可表示喜欢做某事。

Could you please pass me the salt?.g: pass sb sth = pass sth to sb，餐桌常用语。

I think I have caught a cold because my.t: 我觉得我感冒了，因为我嗓子疼。
I think I have caught a cold because my.g: have caught 为现在完成时，强调已感冒的结果。

Let's take a photo together before we go.t: 我们回家前一起拍张照吧。
Let's take a photo together before we go.g: home 作副词，go home 不加 to。

The baby is sleeping, so please keep you.g: keep ... down 表示使保持低位，常用于请人安静。

My mother makes the best dumplings in th.t: 我妈妈包的饺子是世界上最好吃的。
My mother makes the best dumplings in th.g: 最高级前加 the，常与 in + 范围 连用。

We usually visit our grandparents on Sun.t: 我们通常在星期天下午去看望祖父母。
We usually visit our grandparents on Sun.g: 具体某天的上下午用 on；复数表示经常性。

Would you like to come to my party on Sa.t: 你周六想来参加我的聚会吗？
Would you like to come to my party on Sa.g: 接受邀请答 I'd love to；星期前用 on。

I'm afraid I can't come because I have t.t: 恐怕我来不了，因为我得完成作业。
I'm afraid I can't come because I have t.g: I'm afraid 用于委婉拒绝，并非“害怕”。

He always drinks a glass of warm milk be.t: 他总是在睡前喝一杯热牛奶。
He always drinks a glass of warm milk be.g: before bed 是固定说法，bed 前不加冠词。

Could you answer the phone for me while.t: 我做饭的时候你能帮我接一下电话吗？
Could you answer the phone for me while.g: while 常接进行时，表示某动作持续期间。

This dish is a little too spicy for me..t: 这道菜对我来说有点太辣了。
This dish is a little too spicy for me..g: a little too 委婉表达“有点太”。

There is a small bakery next to our apar.t: 我们公寓楼旁边有一家小面包店。
There is a small bakery next to our apar.g: There is/are 表示“某处有某物”。

I need to buy some bread, eggs, and appl.t: 我回家路上需要买些面包、鸡蛋和苹果。
I need to buy some bread, eggs, and appl.g: 这里 bread 用作不可数名词（指不同种类的面包时可说 breads）；home 前不加 to。

It was nice to meet you, and I hope to s.t: 很高兴认识你，希望很快能再见到你。
It was nice to meet you, and I hope to s.g: 告别时用过去式 It was nice to meet you。

Take care and have a wonderful weekend..g: Have a nice/good ... 是常用的道别祝福。

My sister and I share a bedroom, and we.t: 我和姐姐住同一间卧室，我们常常聊到深夜。
My sister and I share a bedroom, and we.g: 礼貌起见把自己放后面：My sister and I。

Could you help me carry these boxes upst.t: 你能帮我把这些箱子搬到楼上吗？

I'm looking for a birthday present for m.t: 我在给我爸爸找生日礼物。
I'm looking for a birthday present for m.g: look for 强调找的过程，find 强调找到的结果。

Our neighbors have a friendly dog called.t: 我们的邻居有一只叫 Lucky 的友善的狗。
Our neighbors have a friendly dog called.g: called 为过去分词作后置定语，意为“名叫”。

Please wash your hands before you sit do.g: sit down to eat 中不定式表示目的。

On cold winter nights, the whole family.t: 在寒冷的冬夜，全家人围坐在火炉旁，喝着热茶，讲着故事。
On cold winter nights, the whole family.g: drinking 和 telling 是现在分词，表示伴随动作。

My grandmother grows tomatoes and beans.t: 我奶奶在她的菜园里种西红柿和豆子，每年秋天她都教我们做她最喜欢的菜。
My grandmother grows tomatoes and beans.g: 疑问词 + 不定式（how to cook）可作宾语。

Could you explain that word again, pleas.t: 请您再解释一下那个词好吗？
Could you explain that word again, pleas.g: Could you...? 是比 Can you...? 更礼貌的请求句式。

How do you pronounce this word?.g: pronounce 是动词，名词是 pronunciation，注意拼写不同。

w: 现在完成进行时：一直在学
I have been learning English for three y.g: have been doing + for 一段时间，表示从过去持续到现在的动作。

Our teacher gave us a lot of homework to.t: 今天老师给我们布置了很多作业。
Our teacher gave us a lot of homework to.g: homework 不可数，不能说 homeworks。

Please open your books to page twenty-fi.t: 请把书翻到第二十五页。
Please open your books to page twenty-fi.g: open to page 25 = 翻到第25页；也可说 turn to page 25。

I don't understand this question, so cou.t: 我不明白这个问题，您能帮帮我吗？
I don't understand this question, so cou.g: so 连接因果：前因后果，意为“所以”。

Reading English stories before bed helps.t: 睡前读英文故事帮助我学习新单词。
Reading English stories before bed helps.g: 动名词短语 Reading... 作主语，谓语用单数 helps。

Listen carefully and repeat after me..g: repeat after me 是课堂常用语“跟我读”。

The exam will start at nine o'clock tomo.t: 考试将在明天早上九点开始。
The exam will start at nine o'clock tomo.g: o'clock 只用于整点；时间状语顺序由小到大：九点→明早。

I always write new words in a small note.t: 我总是把新单词写在一个小本子上。
I always write new words in a small note.g: 频度副词 always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

Mistakes are a normal part of learning a.t: 犯错是学习语言的正常组成部分。
Mistakes are a normal part of learning a.g: 介词 of 后接动名词 learning。

Try to guess the meaning of a new word f.t: 试着根据上下文句子猜测生词的意思。

She is preparing for an important job in.t: 她正在为下周一场重要的求职面试做准备。
She is preparing for an important job in.g: prepare for sth. 为某事做准备；prepare sth. 是准备某物。

I will send you the report by Friday aft.t: 我最迟周五下午把报告发给你。
I will send you the report by Friday aft.g: by + 时间：最迟在该时间完成，不晚于它；before 则是在该时间之前。

Let's have a short meeting after lunch t.t: 午饭后我们开个短会讨论一下计划吧。
Let's have a short meeting after lunch t.g: discuss 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不说 discuss about。

He works as a nurse at the city hospital.g: work as + 职业，表示从事某职业。

Please check your answers carefully befo.t: 交卷前请仔细检查答案。
Please check your answers carefully befo.g: hand in 是短语动词，意为“上交”；paper 此处指试卷。

Our school library has thousands of book.t: 我们学校图书馆有数千本英文书。
w: 成千上万的，数以千计的
Our school library has thousands of book.g: thousands of 表概数；具体数字时用 three thousand，不加 s。

Speaking slowly and clearly is more impo.t: 说得慢而清楚比说得快更重要。
Speaking slowly and clearly is more impo.g: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is。

I study for thirty minutes every evening.t: 我每天晚上学习三十分钟，周末也不例外。
I study for thirty minutes every evening.g: even 用来强调出乎意料或更进一步的情况。

Could you check my pronunciation of this.t: 您能帮我检查一下这句话的发音吗？
Could you check my pronunciation of this.g: pronunciation 拼写中是 nun，不是 noun。

My dream is to become a teacher and help.t: 我的梦想是成为一名老师，帮助孩子们学习。
My dream is to become a teacher and help.g: to become... 不定式作表语，说明梦想的内容。

Working in a team teaches us how to list.t: 团队合作教会我们如何倾听他人。
Working in a team teaches us how to list.g: teach sb. how to do sth. 教某人如何做某事。

The teacher asked us to read the first p.t: 老师让我们朗读第一段。
The teacher asked us to read the first p.g: ask sb. to do sth. 要求某人做某事。

The best way to learn a language is to u.t: 学习语言的最好方法就是每天使用它。
The best way to learn a language is to u.g: every day 两个词是副词“每天”；everyday 一个词是形容词“日常的”。

Learning a new language takes time and p.t: 学习一门新语言需要时间和耐心，所以每天读一点，不要害怕犯错。
Learning a new language takes time and p.g: 犯错用 make mistakes，不说 do mistakes。

When you read aloud, speak clearly at a.t: 朗读时要吐字清楚、速度平稳，每个逗号处稍作停顿。
When you read aloud, speak clearly at a.g: at a steady pace 以平稳的速度，介词用 at。

If you practice for just ten minutes eve.t: 如果你每天只练习十分钟，一年后你会惊讶于自己进步有多大。
If you practice for just ten minutes eve.g: if 条件句主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时；progress 不可数。

It's a beautiful sunny day, so let's go.t: 今天阳光明媚，我们去散散步吧。
It's a beautiful sunny day, so let's go.g: Let's do... 用于提议“我们一起……吧”。

The weather forecast says it will snow t.t: 天气预报说明天会下雪。
The weather forecast says it will snow t.g: says 这里指“（文字、预报）写着/说”。

Don't forget to bring your passport and.t: 别忘了带上你的护照和票。
Don't forget to bring your passport and.g: forget to do 忘了去做；forget doing 忘了做过。

How long does it take to get to the airp.g: It takes + 时间 + to do 是表达耗时的常用句型。

Could you tell me the way to the train s.t: 您能告诉我去火车站怎么走吗？
Could you tell me the way to the train s.g: 问路常用：Could you tell me the way to...?

We missed the last bus, so we took a tax.t: 我们错过了末班车，所以打车回家了。
We missed the last bus, so we took a tax.g: home 是副词，take a taxi home 前不加 to。

It is very hot today, so remember to dri.g: plenty of 可接可数或不可数名词。

The wind is so strong that I can hardly.t: 风太大了，我几乎走不动。
The wind is so strong that I can hardly.g: hardly 本身含否定意义，不再与 not 连用。

I would like to book a room for two nigh.t: 我想订一个房间，住两晚。
I would like to book a room for two nigh.g: book 作动词意为“预订”，如 book a table/ticket。

Is breakfast included in the price?.g: 被动语态 be included，住酒店时常用问句。

The view from the top of the mountain wa.g: -ing 形容词描述事物令人……；-ed 形容词描述人的感受。

Take an umbrella with you because it mig.t: 带把伞吧，待会儿可能会下雨。
Take an umbrella with you because it mig.g: might 表示可能性较小的推测；take sth. with you 随身带。

We are going to the beach for our summer.g: 现在进行时 are going 可表示已安排好的将来计划。

Excuse me, which platform does the train.t: 打扰一下，去伦敦的火车从几号站台出发？
Excuse me, which platform does the train.g: 介词 from 放在句末是英语疑问句的常见用法。

The flight has been delayed because of t.g: because of + 名词；because + 句子。

Spring is warm and windy, and the flower.t: 春天温暖多风，花儿开始绽放。
Spring is warm and windy, and the flower.g: begin to do 开始做某事。

Autumn mornings are cool and clear in my.t: 在我的家乡，秋天的早晨凉爽而晴朗。
Autumn mornings are cool and clear in my.g: autumn 结尾 n 不发音；美式多用 fall。

Could you recommend a good local restaur.t: 您能推荐一家不错的本地餐馆吗？
Could you recommend a good local restaur.g: recommend 拼写：一个 c，两个 m。

I'm lost, so could you show me where we.t: 我迷路了，您能在这张地图上指给我看我们在哪儿吗？
I'm lost, so could you show me where we.g: where we are 是宾语从句，用陈述语序。

We took hundreds of photos during our tr.t: 我们在山区旅行时拍了几百张照片。
We took hundreds of photos during our tr.g: 拍照用 take photos；trip to 去某地的旅行。

Last summer my family went to the seasid.t: 去年夏天我们全家去了海边，每天早上游泳，每天傍晚看日落。
Last summer my family went to the seasid.g: where 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 the seaside。

The train was so crowded that we had to.t: 火车太挤了，整整两个小时的旅程我们都只能站在门边。
The train was so crowded that we had to.g: two-hour 作形容词，hour 用单数且加连字符。

Go straight along this street, turn left.t: 沿着这条街直走，在第二个红绿灯左转，博物馆就在你右边。
Go straight along this street, turn left.g: 祈使句 + and + 将来时，表示“做了……就会……”。

Every morning I wake up at six, drink a.t: 每天早上我六点醒来，喝一杯水，早饭前在公园里散一会儿步。
Every morning I wake up at six, drink a.g: 一般现在时表示日常习惯；三个动作并列用逗号和 and。

The library in our town is open every da.t: 我们镇上的图书馆每天开放，任何人都可以免费借书或使用电脑。
The library in our town is open every da.g: borrow 是“借入”，lend 是“借出”，别混用。

Our class is planning a picnic next Satu.t: 我们班计划下周六去野餐，每个人都会带些好吃的东西来分享。
Our class is planning a picnic next Satu.g: something 的形容词要后置：something delicious。

Before going to bed, I put my phone away.t: 睡觉前，我会把手机收起来，读几页好书，帮助自己放松。
Before going to bed, I put my phone away.g: before 后接动名词：before going to bed。

w: adv. 更响亮地；此处比喻更有说服力（loud 的比较级）
Actions speak louder than words..g: 谚语：做比说更能证明一个人。

Practice makes perfect..g: 谚语：通过反复练习，才能达到熟练或完善。

Where there's a will, there's a way..g: 谚语：只要决心够强，总能找到办法。will 此处是名词。

Don't count your chickens before they ha.t: 蛋未孵出，先别数鸡；别高兴得太早。
Don't count your chickens before they ha.g: 谚语：事情还没成功之前，别过早打如意算盘。

w: v. 建造（build 的过去分词）
Rome wasn't built in a day..g: 谚语：大事需要长期努力，不可急于求成。被动语态。

The early bird catches the worm..g: 谚语：先行动的人先得到机会。

A friend in need is a friend indeed..g: 谚语：在你困难时帮你的才是真朋友。

Better late than never..g: 谚语：晚一点也比永远不做强。省略句，完整为 It is better…

Every cloud has a silver lining..g: 谚语：再糟的处境也有好的一面。

Honesty is the best policy..g: 谚语：诚实做人做事最终最有利。honesty 的 h 不发音。

Time and tide wait for no man..g: 谚语：时间一去不返，要抓紧时机。

Two heads are better than one..t: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮。
Two heads are better than one..g: 谚语：两人一起想办法胜过一个人。

When in Rome, do as the Romans do..g: 谚语：到了别处就遵从当地习俗。When in Rome 省略了 you are。

An apple a day keeps the doctor away..t: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。
An apple a day keeps the doctor away..g: 谚语：坚持健康饮食就少生病。a day 表示“每天”。

All that glitters is not gold..g: 谚语：外表好看不代表有价值。all…not 为部分否定。

A journey of a thousand miles begins wit.g: 源自老子：再大的目标也要从第一步做起。

Don't judge a book by its cover..g: 谚语：不能只凭外表判断人或事。judge…by… 凭……判断。

Look before you leap..g: 谚语：行动前先想清楚后果。

No pain, no gain..g: 谚语：不吃苦就没有收获。pain 与 gain 押韵。

w: adj. 更强大的（mighty 比较级）
The pen is mightier than the sword..g: 谚语：文字思想比武力更有影响力。sword 的 w 不发音。

Easy come, easy go..g: 谚语：轻易得来的东西（尤指钱）也容易失去。

Birds of a feather flock together..g: 谚语：性情相近的人会聚在一起。

Great minds think alike..g: 常用作玩笑：两人想法一致时说。

It's never too late to learn..g: 谚语：任何年纪学习都不算晚。too…to… 结构。

Laughter is the best medicine..g: 谚语：快乐有益身心健康。

Necessity is the mother of invention..g: 谚语：人们在迫切需要时最能想出新办法。

Out of sight, out of mind..g: 谚语：久不见面，感情或记忆就会淡去。

Slow and steady wins the race..g: 源自龟兔赛跑：稳步坚持胜过急躁。主语视为整体用单数。

There's no place like home..t: 金窝银窝，不如自己的狗窝。

Beauty is in the eye of the beholder..g: 谚语：美是主观的，因人而异。

Don't put all your eggs in one basket..t: 不要把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。
w: put all your eggs in one basket
Don't put all your eggs in one basket..g: 谚语：要分散风险，别把希望押在一处。

Every dog has its day..g: 谚语：再普通的人也会有成功的时刻。its 不是 it's。

Fortune favors the bold..g: 谚语：敢于冒险的人更易成功。the + 形容词 表一类人。

Haste makes waste..g: 谚语：做事太急反而出错、白费力气。

w: kill two birds with one stone
Kill two birds with one stone..g: 习语：一个行动同时达成两个目的。

Many hands make light work..g: 谚语：大家一起干，活就轻松了。light 此处意为“轻松”。

No news is good news..g: 谚语：没听到消息说明没出事。news 不可数，作单数。

Patience is a virtue..g: 谚语：劝人耐心等待，不要急躁。

Seeing is believing..g: 谚语：亲眼看到才可信。动名词作主语和表语。

Strike while the iron is hot..g: 谚语：抓住时机立即行动。

You reap what you sow..g: 谚语：自己的行为决定后果。sow 读 /səʊ/。

A picture is worth a thousand words..g: 谚语：图像比文字更直观。be worth + 名词。

Knowledge is power..g: 培根名言。knowledge 的 k 不发音，不可数。

Where there's smoke, there's fire..g: 谚语：有传言，往往事出有因。

A bird in the hand is worth two in the b.t: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。
A bird in the hand is worth two in the b.g: 谚语：已到手的东西比不确定的更可贵。

Still waters run deep..g: 谚语：沉默寡言的人往往内心深沉、有见识。

Every little helps..g: 谚语：哪怕一点点贡献也有用。
